MAX_PLAYERS.desc: Maximum number of players on the server (1-32)

SERVER_PASSWORD.desc: Join password, at most 30 characters. Strongly recommended.

SRCDS_APPID.desc: SteamCMD application id of the Stormworks: Build and Rescue dedicated server

STEAM64_ID.desc: 17 digit SteamID64 granted admin on the server

STEAM_AUTH.desc: Steam Guard code. Only needed when the account has two-factor enabled.

STEAM_USER.desc: Steam account that owns Stormworks. The server files ship with the base game, so an anonymous install is not possible.

UPDATE_ON_BOOT.desc: Run SteamCMD before every server start so the server is always up to date

WORLD_SEED.desc: Seed of the generated world. 0 draws a random one on install.

port.desc: UDP port the game server binds to
